entry_points.text: Fast entries are queued read, write and spin lock with try and unlock, atomic read and single-access read, with dynamic init for spin, rwsem, seqlock and lockref and static unlocked forms, plus percpu shared take, refcount read, rt-mutex take and generic rw take and release.

Slow entries hash futexes preferring the private table, resolve keys, wake with PI rejection, dispatch wait, wake, requeue and PI, move waiters with prefix wake and value checks, enforce robust size and permissions, and sum lock events; lockdep registers and validates classes, tracks irqs, frees ranges, reports via proc, with torture workers and RT rwsem delegation.

exports.text: Raw atomics provide exchange, compare-exchange, add, sub and bitwise fetch across full, acquire, release and relaxed orderings, with guarded add, inc, dec and add-unless reporting status and skipping the store when the guard fails.

Instrumented 32, 64 and long wrappers mark access and barrier flavor then delegate with the same ordering; barriers cover full, read, write, SMP, IO, DMA and PMEM; single-access and conditional-load helpers poll predicates.

Blocking acquisition covers mutex and rt-mutex with interruptible, killable and try forms, wound-wait contextual take, rwsem shared and exclusive takes with nested, try, downgrade and non-owner forms, and counting semaphore takes with timeout and release.

Spin family covers queued, raw and RT spin and reader-writer lock, try and unlock in plain, irq-save, irq, bottom-half and nested forms with polling and relax, plus seqlock writers, MCS queue acquire and PV unlock.

Futex services cover PI acquire, release and repair with shared and private scope and timeout forms, RT proxy start and wait with chain walk, requeue onto plain or PI with prefix wake and value check, and lockdep key registration with chain and irq-map handling.

hazards.text: Word-at-a-time loads can race stores and must not replace single-access use, some ordered bitwise fetch forms lack fallback, and holder compare needs a valid writable correctly sized and aligned holder; raising zero, exceeding max or releasing at zero saturates refcount with a warning, and releasing a clear bit lock is fatal.

Unsynchronized contended and irq-flag queries are advisory, odd spinning can stall readers and unchecked retry lacks read ordering the caller must supply; uniprocessor acquire gives no exclusion with try always succeeding; RT may ignore irq flags; lockdep pool exhaustion disables checking with diagnostics and unlock or pin misuse warns.

Signal and timeout exits must remove the waiter under protection and propagate wakes or acquirers stall with stale records, and callers must not assume ownership on failure; unresolvable user access can diverge kernel and user owners causing later unlock rejection, non-PI wake of PI waiters is refused, and duplicate wound-wait completion or freeing held locks warns.

invariants.text: Acquire appends an after-fence and release prepends a before-fence; missing ordered forms combine relaxed operations with fences while preferring native ordered operations; long helpers preserve ordering while selecting 32 or 64 bit width; wrappers add no exclusion.

Try reports positive on success and zero on failure leaving state unchanged, with failed multiprocessor attempts undoing masking while uniprocessor try always succeeds; even seqcount is stable and odd is updating; refcount saturates and warns on misuse; null RT owner means unlocked.

Private futex keys lack shared markers and buckets prefer the private table else the global hash; classic flags default to 32 bit and only that width validates; one build bounds reader-owned spinning with expiry while an alternate build disables owner spinning.

Lockdep classes live in one list with back-referenced dependencies, chain keys fold iteratively, the chain cache probes unlocked then locked with bucketed id blocks, and marking is idempotent with read flavor; percpu writers move announced, contended, draining and held with CPU-sum quiescence; RT waiters order by priority then stamp.

locks.text: Queued read lock adds reader bias and unwinds on writer bits while write lock moves empty to held, with unlock reversing; queued spin fast path exchanges zero to locked, any nonzero sample fails try, and release clears the locked byte with release ordering.

Multiprocessor raw lock masks context, disables preemption, records dependencies then spins on try until held, with unlock recording release then restoring in reverse; RT nested validates the outer lock; debug success records processor and context with release validating tag and identity.

Mutex, wound-wait and semaphore queues are guarded by a waiter lock under irq protection with deferred wakes past the guard; RT mark uses irqsave and dequeues the top waiter with preemption disabled; wound-wait detaches context before unlock; rwsem wake selection runs under the wait lock with batched delivery.

Futex insert counts before taking the bucket, enqueue holds both buckets ordered by address, PI updates take the bucket before the wait lock with faults dropping both then reacquiring in order; lockdep graph mutation holds the graph lock with irqs off; percpu slow paths hold the inner lock masked; local locks mask preemption or irqs, or migration on RT.

state_machines.text: Guarded atomics observe, exit on guard failure, else store the successor and retry on loss, with failed compare refreshing the expectation; queued spin waits for pending then queues, tail-waits and hands off with PV spin, halt and kick; rwsem optimistic spin secures a slot, observes owner and retries unqueued acquire.

Mutex moves from fast retry to spin to queued sleep with handoff while wound-wait contexts move init to done to fini with triple unwind and reorder; RT slow paths retry, block ordered and clean up, with unlock queueing the highest waiter; semaphore and rwsem slow paths enqueue, sleep outside the guard and handle grant, timeout and signal with removal.

Futex wait holds the bucket and sleeps until wake, timeout or signal then maps the outcome with spurious retry, with requeue preparation, owner-death checks and exit cleanup bracketing; lockdep initializes once, searches breadth-first with skip and match, reports detected, safe or skip, and tracks binary irq state with commit, merge, truncate and replay.

structs.text: Queued rwlock pairs an atomic counter with a waiter spinlock and queued spinlock packs locked, pending and tail into one 32 bit word; atomic64 wraps an aligned signed counter, refcount adds max and saturated markers, long aliases by word size; seqcount is one word, seqlock pairs it with spin.

Sleeping locks store owner with wait queue and guard or RT base, unlocked as zero with a low writer bit; waiters link task, priority, context, mode and handoff with MCS and OSQ nodes; semaphore waiters add a completion marker; MCS nodes link successors, lockref unions a word with spin plus count.

Futex buckets hold count, lock and chain, PI state links mutex, owner, refcount and key, and waiters link task, locks, key and PI with shared, private and combined key views; UAPI defines ops, private and clock flags, waiters and owner-died bits with low tid; lockdep classes track dependencies, maps hold keys, held entries record sharing, and chains store key, context and depth.
